credits.title: Ice Cream Man
credits.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

credits.title: Youngblood
credits.overview: Hockey prodigy Dean Youngblood joins the Hamilton Mustangs and has to deal with toxic behavior during his journey to the National Hockey League draft.

credits.title: Crocus
credits.overview: Trapped in limbo by the vivid memories of his recently departed mother, the family home becomes an allegory for a son's loss.

credits.title: All is Fine in '89
credits.overview: November 9, 1989 - With the backdrop of the Berlin Wall being torn down and the Cold War coming to an end, the senior students - and even teachers - at Romano High are obliviously prepping for the last field party of the decade - and for some, the last party of their lives.
